fact: The council's first-half 2026 report lists the launch of a smart judicial assistant among achievements.
The IDSC policy perspective says AI projects are proceeding in governmental entities on health, water management and agriculture, with no tool stated in service.

Daily News Egypt reports NARSS, with the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, used remote sensing and artificial intelligence to inventory and classify crops by governorate, producing a 2023-24 winter crop map presented in November 2024.

Egypt Today reports the Ministry of Irrigation and Water Resources began a pilot in Kafr El Sheikh developing machine-learning algorithms that produce crop type maps from satellite images to guide irrigation water distribution.
Egyptian Tax Authority head Rasha Abdel Aal said a mobile app to calculate real estate disposal tax using AI algorithms is about to launch, with an AI tax assistant platform being prepared.

fact: Customs head Ahmed Amoy said Egypt has begun running three smart systems on the Nafeza platform, including automated tariff classification using AI algorithms, automated valuation against past records, and a risk system that scores each shipment before arrival.
system: Nafeza automated classification, valuation and risk systems

fact: Dr Mohamed Fawzy, adviser to the Minister of Health and Population for radiology, said AI applications are used daily in some hospitals and institutes to diagnose breast, prostate and brain tumours, with expansion to other devices under way.
system: AI radiology applications for tumour diagnosis
